metadata.question: Was there a noticeable larger bloom (represented by a brighter blue color) in Hood Canal in late August 2022, compared to August 2021?

data.raw_code: The question asks about comparing blue color (likely representing algal blooms) in Hood Canal between late August 2022 and August 2021. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery which has good blue band (B2) and spatial resolution 2. Focus on the Hood Canal area in Washington state 3. Compare mean blue reflectance between the two time periods 4. Use cloud masking to ensure data quality 5. Check for valid data and handle edge cases For the comparison: - Late August 2022: Aug 20-31, 2022 - August 2021: Aug 1-31, 2021 (wider range since question says "August 2021") I'll use the blue band (B2) from Sentinel-2 and compute mean reflectance in the Hood Canal area. If 2022 has significantly higher blue reflectance, answer "A: Yes", otherwise "B: No". Need to handle: - No images in either period (C1) - No valid pixels after cloud masking (C2) - Invalid calculations (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const hoodCanal = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-123.0, 47.8], [-122.6, 47.8], [-122.6, 47.2], [-123.0, 47.2], [-123.0, 47.8] ]); // Time periods: late Aug 2022 vs full Aug 2021 const start2022 = '2022-08-20'; const end2022 = '2022-08-31'; const start2021 = '2021-08-01'; const end2021 = '2021-08-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for blue band analysis function getSentinel2Collection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(hoodCanal) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(function(image) { // Cloud masking using QA60 band var qa = image.select('QA60'); var cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; var cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask).select(['B2']); // Blue band }); } const col2022 = getSentinel2Collection(start2022, end2022); const col2021 = getSentinel2Collection(start2021, end2021); // Check collection sizes const size2022 = col2022.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2022 Images: ${size2022}, 2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size2022 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composites const comp2022 = col2022.median(); const comp2021 = col2021.median(); // Calculate mean blue reflectance and pixel counts function getStats(image, year) { const stats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: hoodCanal, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean = stats.get('B2').getInfo(); const count = stats.get('B2_count').getInfo(); console.log(`${year} Mean Blue: ${mean ? mean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}, Pixels: ${count}`); return {mean: mean, count: count}; } const stats2022 = getStats(comp2022, "2022"); const stats2021 = getStats(comp2021, "2021"); // Check for valid pixels if (stats2022.count === 0 || stats2021.count === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (stats2022.mean === null || stats2021.mean === null || isNaN(stats2022.mean) || isNaN(stats2021.mean)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare blue reflectance - if 2022 is at least 10% higher than 2021 const diff = ((stats2022.mean - stats2021.mean) / stats2021.mean) * 100; console.log(`Blue reflectance difference: ${diff.toFixed(1)}%`); if (diff > 10) { // 10% threshold for "noticeable" difference console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
